epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在納米比亞中部,一群非洲野犬在乾旱的土地上漫遊.受到獅子和乾旱兩面夾擊,一隻名為賴卡的勇敢幼崽必須快速成長,學習獵人的技能,並找到自己在族群中的定位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探訪喀拉喀托之子火山(Anak Krakatoa),當它進入劇烈活躍階段時.這座火山被稱為「火之子」,它是喀拉喀托火山的後代,而喀拉喀托火山以現代史上最大規模的噴發而聞名.它的後代是否會重演同樣的模式?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit Anak Krakatoa as it enters a violent phase. Known as The Child of Fire, this volcano is an ancestor of Krakatoa, a volcano known for the largest eruption in modern history. Will its descendant repeat the pattern?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎來豐饒季節的問候,當洪水退去,大群獵物再度回到喬貝河岸邊,重現成群聚集的壯觀場景.觀看琪薩帶著幼崽嘗試逃離,卡勒與湯湯則與對手搏鬥激戰,然後歡呼愛因斯坦終於找到配偶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobes banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿曼海岸附近,夏季天氣在海洋深處與阿拉伯陽光的交匯處驅生養分,從而迸發生命.產下較小的魚,水中充滿魚卵.這成了肉食性動物無法抗拒的自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just cant resist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是阿曼灣的夏天.熾熱的阿拉伯陽光將淺水區加熱到86度,促進了廣闊珊瑚礁上藻類的生長.這吸引了成千上萬飢腸轆轆的草食性動物,引發了一場魚類之間的角力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奈士富獅群生活在尚比亞的盧安瓜河畔.見證經驗豐富的雌獅養育一群幼獅,還有牠們如何在惡劣環境中努力生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nsefu lion pride welcomes seven new cubs during the wet season, when antelope and buffalo are spread far from the river, making them harder to hunt. Learn how the mother lionesses work to keep the boisterous cubs alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾的南部邊界,有著世上獨一無二最大的熱帶濕地,野生動植物的多樣性使科學家們爭相瞭解動物的各種互動方式.博多克納山的高地是隱密的潘塔納爾濕地的入口.那裡的水十分清澈,因由超過6億年歷史的石灰岩所形成過濾層,為這些溪流中的生命提供了一個清晰的門戶. 瀑布,凝灰岩水壩,洞穴和純淨的河流,能見...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the southern edge of the Pantanal, where brown capuchin monkeys live in their own Garden of Eden. Dry season in the highlands treats them well until a drought dries up their food sources. Can an industrious agouti save them from starvation?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追蹤遍布全球閃閃發光的水域,從俄羅斯遠東的火山河流到佛羅里達充滿地熱的溪流.觀看海狸以巧妙精密的建築技術改變整片自然景觀,築起完整的水壩,塑造出新的水域生態;隨後,享受與海牛共度的冬季水療日,感受溫暖平靜的水中悠閒時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russias far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿曼海岸附近,夏季天氣在海洋深處與阿拉伯陽光的交匯處驅生養分,從而迸發生命.產下較小的魚,水中充滿魚卵.這成了肉食性動物無法抗拒的自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just cant resist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是阿曼灣的夏天.熾熱的阿拉伯陽光將淺水區加熱到86度,促進了廣闊珊瑚礁上藻類的生長.這吸引了成千上萬飢腸轆轆的草食性動物,引發了一場魚類之間的角力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奈士富獅群生活在尚比亞的盧安瓜河畔.見證經驗豐富的雌獅養育一群幼獅,還有牠們如何在惡劣環境中努力生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nsefu lion pride welcomes seven new cubs during the wet season, when antelope and buffalo are spread far from the river, making them harder to hunt. Learn how the mother lionesses work to keep the boisterous cubs alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾的南部邊界,有著世上獨一無二最大的熱帶濕地,野生動植物的多樣性使科學家們爭相瞭解動物的各種互動方式.博多克納山的高地是隱密的潘塔納爾濕地的入口.那裡的水十分清澈,因由超過6億年歷史的石灰岩所形成過濾層,為這些溪流中的生命提供了一個清晰的門戶. 瀑布,凝灰岩水壩,洞穴和純淨的河流,能見...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the southern edge of the Pantanal, where brown capuchin monkeys live in their own Garden of Eden. Dry season in the highlands treats them well until a drought dries up their food sources. Can an industrious agouti save them from starvation?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨羅傑為夏季小熊的野放做好準備,然後一起認識兩位新來的小熊--艾斯和小藍莓;牠們因嚴重的健康問題,必須在營中暫住,與新一批小熊們一起過冬.最後,一同慶祝六隻健康快樂的熊寶貝踏上全新的野外生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎來豐饒季節的問候,當洪水退去,大群獵物再度回到喬貝河岸邊,重現成群聚集的壯觀場景.觀看琪薩帶著幼崽嘗試逃離,卡勒與湯湯則與對手搏鬥激戰,然後歡呼愛因斯坦終於找到配偶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobes banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 意大利的埃特納火山是對火山觀測者來說最好的地方之一,火山學家湯菲佛希望幸運地看到陣發性爆發,那是一次短暫而強烈的噴發,會產生壯觀的熔岩噴泉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italys Mount Etna is one of the best places for volcano watchers and volcanologist Tom Pfeffier is hoping to get lucky and see a paroxysmal eruption, a short and very intense eruption that produces spectacular lava fountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿曼海岸附近,夏季天氣在海洋深處與阿拉伯陽光的交匯處驅生養分,從而迸發生命.產下較小的魚,水中充滿魚卵.這成了肉食性動物無法抗拒的自助餐.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 於11月見證大自然一些最不可思議的事,從聚在墨西哥森林中的數百萬隻君主斑蝶,到籠罩著杜拜市的濃霧,標誌著冬天的開始.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭大雄獅,有著強大的兄弟情誼,統治了奈士富獅群三年,但三年是很長的統治期,其他競爭者逐步進逼.兩兄弟將要竭力保護家族和領導地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Twin brothers with a powerful bond have ruled the Nsefu pride for three years. Theyre fathers to all the young, and protectors of their territory. Witness the struggle that unfolds when rival males target their territory.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘塔納爾的南部濕地於每年都成為鳥類天堂,超過650種珍稀和標誌性的鳥類在繁殖季節中聚集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, the southern wetlands of the Pantanal become a bird paradise as over 650 species of rare and iconic birds congregate here for the breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿曼海岸附近,夏季天氣在海洋深處與阿拉伯陽光的交匯處驅生養分,從而迸發生命.產下較小的魚,水中充滿魚卵.這成了肉食性動物無法抗拒的自助餐.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿越充滿神秘色彩的湖泊世界,見證生命如何在極端環境中適應,存活並改變自己.觀察古老巨獸如鱷龜展現強大的力量,見證蜻蜓從幼蟲蛻變成成蟲的奇妙過程,並隨火烈鳥昂首闊步,勇敢地穿越燃燒,腐蝕性的水域,體驗生命的堅韌與美麗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是阿曼灣的夏天.熾熱的阿拉伯陽光將淺水區加熱到86度,促進了廣闊珊瑚礁上藻類的生長.這吸引了成千上萬飢腸轆轆的草食性動物,引發了一場魚類之間的角力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿越充滿神秘色彩的湖泊世界,見證生命如何在極端環境中適應,存活並改變自己.觀察古老巨獸如鱷龜展現強大的力量,見證蜻蜓從幼蟲蛻變成成蟲的奇妙過程,並隨火烈鳥昂首闊步,勇敢地穿越燃燒,腐蝕性的水域,體驗生命的堅韌與美麗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 於11月見證大自然一些最不可思議的事,從聚在墨西哥森林中的數百萬隻君主斑蝶,到籠罩著杜拜市的濃霧,標誌著冬天的開始.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏威夷島上人氣最高的旅遊景點是一座名為基拉韋亞的火山.在火山口板層突然倒塌後,一場大規模的火山爆發使熔岩枯竭,所以現在的基拉韋亞火山變得穩定,讓地質學家菲臘翁終於有機會探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The number one tourist attraction on the island of Hawaii is a volcano called Kilauea. After a sudden collapse of the crater floor, a massive eruption drains the volcano of lava and now Kilauea is silent. Geologist Phillip Ong finally has his chan...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 於11月見證大自然一些最不可思議的事,從聚在墨西哥森林中的數百萬隻君主斑蝶,到籠罩著杜拜市的濃霧,標誌著冬天的開始.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨阿曼達博士拯救一隻失明的寵物狒狒,並細看夏洛特博士幫一隻跟偷獵者發生衝突的穿山甲進行一場刁鑽的截肢手術.之後,追趕一頭被樹所困的犀牛,兩隻出走的小狒狒和一隻兇猛的巨蜥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tag along as Dr. Amanda rescues a blind pet baboon, and watch Dr. Charlottes tricky surgery on a pangolin whose leg must be amputated after a run-in with poachers. Later, chase a rhino, two young baboons gone AWOL, and a fiesty monitor lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾斯堤的腿部感染妨礙了這頭年輕的麂羚歸野,因而面臨一個艱難的決定.然後跟阿曼達博士一起追蹤並替一隻年輕獅子套上頸圈;檢查一隻生病的叢林嬰兒;迎接中心吵鬧的新成員- 一隻暴躁的灰鸚鵡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Face a tough decision when Estis leg infection puts the brakes on this young duikers release. Then track and collar a young lion with Dr. Amanda; check on an ailing bush baby; and greet the noisy new addition to the center, a grumpy grey parrot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一頭名叫美祖木的年輕雄性鬣狗的故事,圍繞生命中最具挑戰性的旅程- 找一個新家族.作為一名主導雌性的兒子,牠有一個被優待的童年,但當牠的地位在青春期時下降,因牠被母親放逐了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Mizumus status drops during adolescence, his alpha female mother disowns him. Follow his challenging journey to find a new clan while overcoming the threats of charging hippos, hungry crocodiles, a pack of wild dogs, and a hyena-eating leopard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的中心,有一個人跡罕至的偏遠地區.沒有人為干預,使這裡成為三百隻馳名的白唇西貒的棲息地.這些大型類豬哺乳類動物能長到四十五公斤,下巴下有白色條紋,因獨特外觀而得名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek through the forests and savannahs of the Pantanals Nhecolândia region, which is home to noisy herds of peccaries. Follow these pig-like mammals on their daily food-foraging routes, and run into roseate spoonbills and capybaras along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​揭開沼澤地那詭異卻迷人的面紗:這些濕地數百年來激發了無數傳說與民間故事,同時成為連結生與死的重要橋樑.與飢餓的鱷魚一同潛泳,目睹梅花鹿為了覓食而賭上性命的瞬間,並觀察食肉植物迅速捕捉獵物的驚人畫面.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加是地球上任何其他地方都找不到的奇怪動物的家.當這些動物為權位而戰,牠們的戰鬥也很奇特--從象鼻蟲怪異的脖子摔角,到環尾狐猴母嬰間的打鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange - from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur moms that go into battle with baby on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨阿曼達博士拯救一隻失明的寵物狒狒,並細看夏洛特博士幫一隻跟偷獵者發生衝突的穿山甲進行一場刁鑽的截肢手術.之後,追趕一頭被樹所困的犀牛,兩隻出走的小狒狒和一隻兇猛的巨蜥.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與鱷魚爭奪河流的主導權,展開對支配權的激烈較量,然後一瞥極為罕見的紅樹林蛇,以及瀕臨絕種的納巴勒克小袋鼠.前往海洋,看見座頭鯨的母鯨撫育牠們的幼鯨,接著又遭到偽虎鯨的追逐與獵捕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個野狗家族生活在尚比亞盧安瓜谷的一角.雌性的巢內有幼崽,這是她和伴侶生養的最新一窩.許多年齡較大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠們幫助作保姆,並狩獵食物養活家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a close-knit family of wild dogs who work together to raise pups and hunt enough food to feed the whole pack. While their well-coordinated hunts are successful, the wet season brings challenges when some of the team strikes out on their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨阿曼達博士拯救一隻失明的寵物狒狒,並細看夏洛特博士幫一隻跟偷獵者發生衝突的穿山甲進行一場刁鑽的截肢手術.之後,追趕一頭被樹所困的犀牛,兩隻出走的小狒狒和一隻兇猛的巨蜥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tag along as Dr. Amanda rescues a blind pet baboon, and watch Dr. Charlottes tricky surgery on a pangolin whose leg must be amputated after a run-in with poachers. Later, chase a rhino, two young baboons gone AWOL, and a fiesty monitor lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾斯堤的腿部感染妨礙了這頭年輕的麂羚歸野,因而面臨一個艱難的決定.然後跟阿曼達博士一起追蹤並替一隻年輕獅子套上頸圈;檢查一隻生病的叢林嬰兒;迎接中心吵鬧的新成員- 一隻暴躁的灰鸚鵡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Face a tough decision when Estis leg infection puts the brakes on this young duikers release. Then track and collar a young lion with Dr. Amanda; check on an ailing bush baby; and greet the noisy new addition to the center, a grumpy grey parrot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​讓時間凝結,見證水在地球最冰冷的生態系中,如何化為改變的力量.與北極熊一同獵捕毫無防備的海豹,與獼猴在天然的溫泉中沐浴取暖,並體驗北極狐那獨特而靈巧的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earths most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭南島的頂部,你會發現一片兩極對立的土地,這裡是世界上最長的沙洲其中之一,吸引著斑尾塍鹬與飢餓的領航鯨,而淹沒的河谷為暗色斑紋海豚和新澳毛皮海獅提供了自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealands South Island, where one of the worlds longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲擁有各種別樹一幟的生物,成功成為王者的方式也同樣多樣性.海灘變成決鬥場,內陸成了拳擊場,動物們同室干戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a dueling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年...能抵受最惡劣的環境...而且昆蟲,鳥類和動物更喜歡它...巨大的猢猻樹.它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years... that can withstand the harshest conditions... and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other...the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加大狐猴indris是現存原猴類中體型最大的類群,他們每天在雨林中尋找食物和躲避捕食者.讓我們看看這些瀕臨滅絕的靈長類動物如何在迅速縮小的棲息地中克服一切困難生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the story of a day in the life of an Indris Family following a mother, father, and their three offspring around their home in the rainforest of Mantadia National Park in Madagascar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白眉長臂猿是印度叢林的專家.生活在親密的家庭中,少猴花費數年時間學習生存的技能.為你介紹沙馬,牠尋找食物,避開掠食者,並掌握於林木間生活所需的雜技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 印度東北部的草原是地球上最肥沃的棲息地之一,該處生長茂盛的野草,讓罕見的印度犀牛賴以維生,並茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of Indias most iconic creatures to thrive... the Greater One-horned Rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拉達克高原是一片極端之地,但西藏野驢是這片草原的王者.跟隨一匹影響一群雌性的種馬,她有機會繁殖下一代,但若然如此,她必須與那些想要牠皇冠的對手作戰!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ladakh plateau is a land of extremes, but the Tibetan wild ass is the king of this grassland. Follow one stallion as he shadows a herd of females for his chance to sire the next generation, but in doing so, he must battle those wanting his crown!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在灼熱和充滿熱帶風暴的土地上,印度南部平原的生活十分艱苦.但一頭帶著兩隻幼崽的雌性樹懶比比,正迎接她生活上的挑戰,她每刻都要對抗缺水缺糧和掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a land of heat and tropical storms, life on the plains of southern India is tough. But Bibi, a female sloth bear with two cubs, is up for the challenge of her life as she fights against drought, food scarcity, and predators around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著名叫奧廉巴的莽撞雌豹,遊覽尚比亞盧安瓜谷的心臟地帶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the heart of Zambias Luangwa Valley, where shady woodlands and antelope-packed plains offer the perfect hunting grounds for an audacious female leopard named Olimba and the pack she must struggle to control.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奈士富獅群生活在尚比亞的盧安瓜河畔.見證經驗豐富的雌獅養育一群幼獅,還有牠們如何在惡劣環境中努力生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nsefu lion pride welcomes seven new cubs during the wet season, when antelope and buffalo are spread far from the river, making them harder to hunt. Learn how the mother lionesses work to keep the boisterous cubs alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭大雄獅,有著強大的兄弟情誼,統治了奈士富獅群三年,但三年是很長的統治期,其他競爭者逐步進逼.兩兄弟將要竭力保護家族和領導地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Twin brothers with a powerful bond have ruled the Nsefu pride for three years. Theyre fathers to all the young, and protectors of their territory. Witness the struggle that unfolds when rival males target their territory.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一頭名叫美祖木的年輕雄性鬣狗的故事,圍繞生命中最具挑戰性的旅程- 找一個新家族.作為一名主導雌性的兒子,牠有一個被優待的童年,但當牠的地位在青春期時下降,因牠被母親放逐了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Mizumus status drops during adolescence, his alpha female mother disowns him. Follow his challenging journey to find a new clan while overcoming the threats of charging hippos, hungry crocodiles, a pack of wild dogs, and a hyena-eating leopard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個野狗家族生活在尚比亞盧安瓜谷的一角.雌性的巢內有幼崽,這是她和伴侶生養的最新一窩.許多年齡較大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠們幫助作保姆,並狩獵食物養活家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a close-knit family of wild dogs who work together to raise pups and hunt enough food to feed the whole pack. While their well-coordinated hunts are successful, the wet season brings challenges when some of the team strikes out on their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一隻水獺如何融入家中,成為大家庭的一份子;與鵝寶寶貢博一起觀賞河邊景色,並探望一隻不幸失明的刺蝟和他的人類知心友.見證一位泳手與野生灰海豹在水中共舞,並與猴子和藪貓一起度過歡樂時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embrace an invasive nutria whos become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmers bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲.發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一隻水獺如何融入家中,成為大家庭的一份子;與鵝寶寶貢博一起觀賞河邊景色,並探望一隻不幸失明的刺蝟和他的人類知心友.見證一位泳手與野生灰海豹在水中共舞,並與猴子和藪貓一起度過歡樂時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embrace an invasive nutria whos become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmers bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲大草原有著史詩式的景致,無論是砸頭的河馬,荷爾蒙失調的大象還是決鬥的獅子,席捲大草原的戰鬥都同樣是史詩式的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether its head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊覽馬達加斯加高聳的山脈,茂密的熱帶雨林,樹木繁茂的沿海平原和乾燥的沙漠.看看侏羅紀時代的植物,古老的青蛙和爬行動物物種,以及新的漂流者是如何在這些奇特而美麗的風景中進化的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This film travels around the island visiting some of its most striking landscapes to explore how Madagascars species have evolved over time. Madagascar is a strangely beautiful and unique world with a staggering array of habitats and special land...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加有近400種爬行動物,約佔世界冷血動物的一半.觀看變色龍,蛇和300多種五顏六色的青蛙在島上的極端氣候中茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lives of Madagascars cold-blooded creatures. Chameleons, frog, lizards, and snakes have all adapted in order to survive on the island. We take a look at how they find food, reproduce, and avoid predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五月的每天,太陽如常升起.從漢波德企鵝到哥倫比亞雨林的猴子,再到太平洋邊緣的科隆群島奇異美洲鬣蜥,美洲熱帶地區的動物已經準備好抵抗酷熱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow penguins, iguanas, tortoises, frogs and tamarins from Mexico to Peru, and as far west as the Galapagos Islands, as they live out their daily dramas, affected by the suns heat, looming predators and hazardous weather conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏至影響亞洲動物,令越南獼猴進入涼快的水中,使鶴在寒冷的青藏高原上跳舞,並激發一種奇怪的魚出來散步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how creatures from the Tibetan plateau, to the lush rainforests of Thailand, to Vietnams twisted mangroves, survive four extra hours of daylight once a year, searching for food, fighting for dominance and raising their families.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天.雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how one animal familys tragedy is anothers holiday dinner as New Zealands mainland and island creatures, including penguins, flightless birds, sea lions, and sharks, battle to feed and protect their young in this marine environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 印度次大陸的母親節象徵旱季於斯里蘭卡開始,同時於印度結束.對於一隻孟加拉虎媽媽來說,是時候訓練她的幼崽去狩獵了,而獅子和眼鏡蛇則忙於交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out which creatures survive and whose luck will run out as animal mothers and moms-to-be struggle with sweltering temperatures, lurking predators, mating season, and drought on a day that proves to be no holiday.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加州的海灘是世上最美麗的海灘之一,但由於人類對大自然的影響,它們是否會失去平衡?太平洋海岸壯麗的動物群如何在海灘生命線上繼續生活?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankinds effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living... on the living beach?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾的南部邊界,有著世上獨一無二最大的熱帶濕地,野生動植物的多樣性使科學家們爭相瞭解動物的各種互動方式.博多克納山的高地是隱密的潘塔納爾濕地的入口.那裡的水十分清澈,因由超過6億年歷史的石灰岩所形成過濾層,為這些溪流中的生命提供了一個清晰的門戶. 瀑布,凝灰岩水壩,洞穴和純淨的河流,能見...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the southern edge of the Pantanal, where brown capuchin monkeys live in their own Garden of Eden. Dry season in the highlands treats them well until a drought dries up their food sources. Can an industrious agouti save them from starvation?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘塔納爾的南部濕地於每年都成為鳥類天堂,超過650種珍稀和標誌性的鳥類在繁殖季節中聚集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, the southern wetlands of the Pantanal become a bird paradise as over 650 species of rare and iconic birds congregate here for the breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的中心,有一個人跡罕至的偏遠地區.沒有人為干預,使這裡成為三百隻馳名的白唇西貒的棲息地.這些大型類豬哺乳類動物能長到四十五公斤,下巴下有白色條紋,因獨特外觀而得名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek through the forests and savannahs of the Pantanals Nhecolândia region, which is home to noisy herds of peccaries. Follow these pig-like mammals on their daily food-foraging routes, and run into roseate spoonbills and capybaras along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中.牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔.遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎來到印度- 充滿異國的動物和異國的戰事.猴子打得塵土飛揚,印度黑羚在開闊的平原上全面開戰,孔雀哥兒開屏比拼:這些多姿多彩的戰鬥襯得上充滿活力的土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome to India – a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare. Monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在地球上最大,保存最完整的稀樹草原之中;在那裡,哺乳動物和昆蟲都能毫不費力地飛掠空中.了解傳統的野火管理方法,探索一處砂岩避難地,並看著一隻蜜袋鼯試著逃離火焰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心.最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在鬣狗家族中有一個新面孔. 斑斑註定要成為位於尚比亞盧安瓜谷心臟地帶斑鬣狗族群的首領.她自出生起已有崇高身份,但她仍然需要證明自己.族群是一個危險的地方,她必須為自己打出一席位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spotty, a female hyena cub, is destined to be leader of the Chimbwe clan that lives in the heart of Zambias Luangwa Valley. But she has yet to prove herself. Witness her fight to find her place in this savagely competitive family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 脆弱又難以捉摸的豹貓在許多國家都屬於瀕危物種.但在世上最大的熱帶濕地之一的潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊界,這種驚豔的野貓似乎打算捲土重來.一群年輕的野生動物科學家正試圖瞭解原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join a group of wildlife scientists tracking the comeback of the ocelot in the Pantanal. Check in on their network of trail cameras, which capture the movements of this elusive spotted cat, and see the perils it faces, including giant anacondas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往世界各地的海岸線,那裡的食物和棲息地衝突導致了絕望的生存之戰.目睹企鹅們從愉悅的性情轉變為兇殘的憤怒,進入一頭保護幼崽的座頭鯨的世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Massive elephant seals go nose to nose to win the title of beachmaster, and giant petrels earn the nickname, murderous garbagemen. Meanwhile, a female humpback goes to extremes to protect her calf from amorous males.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心.最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的塞德堡山脈是一片多年來由風,水和火雕琢而成的奇石地貌.這些壯觀的山峰是眾多不同植物和動物的家.但這裡亦有些看不見的東西,墊伏在陰暗處伺機攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rocky landscape, carved over eons by wind, water and fire, these are the Cederberg Mountains of South Africa. These imposing peaks are home to an incredible diversity of plants and animals. But there are some here that remain unseen, lurking in ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們將帶領您環繞著赤道,深入探索居住在熱帶森林中的多樣物種,您將有機會遇見一隻獨自打造迷你森林的樹懶,與共享互助的狐猴,以及細心照料林地花園的象群,隨後,我們將一同揭開熱帶森林的神秘面紗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西亞馬遜熱帶雨林南部邊界的一片受保護森林中,居住著新世界最聰明和最敏捷的猴子之一 - 亞馬遜蛛猴.長尾巴就如牠們的第五個肢體,牠們很少離開森林的樹梢而走到地面.牠們是森林的「大使」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get an inside look at the Pantanals most extraordinary primate families. Check out the ear-splitting cries of howler monkeys, the fearless leaps of curious saki monkeys, and the agile tails of highly intelligent white-whiskered spider monkeys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心.最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的塞德堡山脈是一片多年來由風,水和火雕琢而成的奇石地貌.這些壯觀的山峰是眾多不同植物和動物的家.但這裡亦有些看不見的東西,墊伏在陰暗處伺機攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rocky landscape, carved over eons by wind, water and fire, these are the Cederberg Mountains of South Africa. These imposing peaks are home to an incredible diversity of plants and animals. But there are some here that remain unseen, lurking in ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們將帶領您環繞著赤道,深入探索居住在熱帶森林中的多樣物種,您將有機會遇見一隻獨自打造迷你森林的樹懶,與共享互助的狐猴,以及細心照料林地花園的象群,隨後,我們將一同揭開熱帶森林的神秘面紗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在納米比亞中部,一群非洲野犬在乾旱的土地上漫遊.受到獅子和乾旱兩面夾擊,一隻名為賴卡的勇敢幼崽必須快速成長,學習獵人的技能,並找到自己在族群中的定位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of A Gold Digger Killer

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Celeste Beards multimillionaire husband was killed by her delusional and disturbed friend Tracey, Celeste was certain she would never be blamed. But Celestes twin daughters discovered the truth and works to bring her to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: “Shark Business” unravels some of the mysteries surrounding sharks with controversial behaviorist Dr. Erich Ritter. You'll witness divers testing the limits of shark-human interaction outside of cages with dangerous sharks such as lemon, bull and even great white sharks!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation. Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Home to an extraordinary biodiversity, the jungles of Asia are among the most ancient rainforests on Earth – they are also among the planet’s most rapidly disappearing habitats.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Home to an extraordinary biodiversity, the jungles of Asia are among the most ancient rainforests on Earth – they are also among the planet’s most rapidly disappearing habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation. Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 演員具本承帶大家慢遊江畔的韓國鄉村,感受當地的溫暖和純淨,並展示沿江村莊的歷史與風土人情 .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Actor Gu Bon-seung shows the warmth and purity of life in the village along the river, and presents how new history was made and became ones memory.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在孕育他們烹飪根基的土地上,韓國頂級名廚化身基層廚房員工!拋開頭銜和名聲,他們能否在五天內證明自己的廚藝,贏得當地人的認可?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top celebrity chefs go undercover as a junior kitchen staff in the very country that shaped their culinary roots, challenge to earn recognition from locals in 5 days!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 六位同齡單身明星齊聚舊基洞,以生活伴侶的身份展開真實同居生活,體驗並累積各種新鮮回憶,重新詮釋現代家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Six single celebrities in their 40s choose co-living in Gugi-dong as Life Mates, sharing laughter, challenges, and fresh memories while redefining modern family through friendship.

epg.programme_title_tc: 在大韓民國成為屋主的方法 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述一名中產家庭男主角如何在為守住家庭與資產的掙扎中,走向綁架等非法行為的邊緣,試圖呈現當代社會階級移動與金融風險交織下的人性選擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upon achieving the coveted status of a landlord, mounting debts lead Soo-Jong into participating a staged kidnapping, yet the plan spirals out of control as the fake kidnapping turns dangerously real.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在紐奧良與食物歷史學家璽拉爬瑪和食譜作家添麥菲帕鋼一起探索一系列迷人的路易斯安素食名產--素貝涅餅,秋葵濃湯,餅乾和窮鬼三明治.作為餐前後酒,他在紐奧良這座大城市中心一邊品酒一邊上雞尾酒調製的一課.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Big Easy, Mena explores a charming host of plant-based Louisiana staples-vegan beignets, gumbo, biscuits and po boys-with food historian Zella Palmer and cookbook author Timothy Pakron. As an aperitif, he sips his way through a lesson in cockt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與拉斯維加斯傳奇魔術師佩恩吉列特吃飯.他探索賭場大道以外的罪惡之城素食現場,沉溺於素威靈頓牛扒,超多層的窩夫和精緻的點心,然後與食譜作家卡妮博妯共進晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena feasts with magician and Vegas legend Penn Jillette. He explores the off-strip Sin City vegan food scene, indulging in plant-based 「Beef」 Wellington, sky-high waffles, and intricate dim sum, then dines with cookbook author Carleigh Bodrug.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿沐浴在陽光和拉丁文化中,學習製作經典的古巴菜和傳統的波多黎各素磨豐果.他與食譜作家華迪迪芙路基亞一起揚帆出海,帶著演員麥梅利到南海灘品嚐垂涎欲滴的心太軟蛋糕,又採摘和品嚐令人驚豔的異國水果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bathed in sunshine and Big Latin Culture, Mena learns to make classic Cubanos and traditional Puerto Rican mofongo-vegan-style. He cruises the seas with cookbook author Radhi Devlukia, takes actor Matt Murray to South Beach for mouth-watering molten

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭比娃娃在2024年慶祝65歲生日.但她不僅是一塊12英寸長的塑膠或一個玩具. 這位傳奇金髮美女已成為一種現象和小孩們的寵兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie celebrates her 65th birthday in 2024. But she is way more than just a 12-inches long piece of plastic and way more than a toy. The legendary blond bombshell has grown into a phenomenon and a children’s sensation.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍娜·傑克森:誘惑的藝術
epg.programme_title_en: Janet Jackson: The Art Of Seduction
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性,有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Noted for her fierce independence, her magnetic aura and her ever so charming voice, Janet Jackson became a catalyst for her growth on MTV; embracing her identity, and reaching up to the heights of stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合天命真女主唱到現在的單飛生涯.探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles-Carter, from her early days as the lead singer of Destinys Child to her solo career. Discover how the superstars music style and inspirations have developed over the years.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The end of winter heralds one of the worlds greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計.軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze a

epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈,繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物.這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠,巨大的鑽石和 世上最大的內陸綠洲之上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿沐浴在陽光和拉丁文化中,學習製作經典的古巴菜和傳統的波多黎各素磨豐果.他與食譜作家華迪迪芙路基亞一起揚帆出海,帶著演員麥梅利到南海灘品嚐垂涎欲滴的心太軟蛋糕,又採摘和品嚐令人驚豔的異國水果.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在日本的中心狼吞虎嚥著素壽司和拉麵.他從新學習煮蕎麥麵,自製麻糬,並參加傳統茶道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Japan, Mena devours plant-based sushi and ramen. He learns to cook soba noodles from scratch, home-made mochi, and takes part in a traditional tea ceremony.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合天命真女主唱到現在的單飛生涯.探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles-Carter, from her early days as the lead singer of Destinys Child to her solo career. Discover how the superstars music style and inspirations have developed over the years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索年輕的諾瑪珍.在展現才華和膽色的同時,她拋開艱辛的童年,以瑪麗蓮夢露的身份進入好萊塢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the young Norma Jeane. While showing talent and audacity, she turned her back on her difficult childhood and put herself on the radar in Hollywood as 『Marilyn Monroe』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到好萊塢的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展,個人生活,心理健康,慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business is a documentary tracing the actors rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想徵戰澳門格蘭披治大賽.她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手.她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amateur driver Vivian Siu chases her dream of racing the Macau Grand Prix. Self-funded and with minimal experience, she quickly jumps to Formula 4, becoming the first female driver in the Chinese Championship. She faces the huge challenge of driving

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結.即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車,車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vivians journey hits a roadblock when the Macau Grand Prix is removed from the calendar, threatening to end her dream. Even with a small chance of hope, she faces the immense task of securing a car, a team, and a co-driver in mere weeks.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.programme_title_en: Bruce Lee: The Way Of The Warrior
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李小龍,好萊塢電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友.《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend. 『The Way of the Warrior』 takes a comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索年輕的諾瑪珍.在展現才華和膽色的同時,她拋開艱辛的童年,以瑪麗蓮夢露的身份進入好萊塢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the young Norma Jeane. While showing talent and audacity, she turned her back on her difficult childhood and put herself on the radar in Hollywood as 『Marilyn Monroe』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討瑪麗蓮如何反對裸體,以及她怎樣一躍成星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠,巨大的鑽石和 世上最大的內陸綠洲之上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線,注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到好萊塢的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展,個人生活,心理健康,慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business is a documentary tracing the actors rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想徵戰澳門格蘭披治大賽.她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手.她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amateur driver Vivian Siu chases her dream of racing the Macau Grand Prix. Self-funded and with minimal experience, she quickly jumps to Formula 4, becoming the first female driver in the Chinese Championship. She faces the huge challenge of driving

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結.即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車,車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vivians journey hits a roadblock when the Macau Grand Prix is removed from the calendar, threatening to end her dream. Even with a small chance of hope, she faces the immense task of securing a car, a team, and a co-driver in mere weeks.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.programme_title_en: Bruce Lee: The Way Of The Warrior
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李小龍,好萊塢電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友.《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend. 『The Way of the Warrior』 takes a comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的土壤姐妹運動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s asparagus season - Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the 『Soil Sisters』 a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術.他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣前往世上最大的自動化包裹分類設施 - 位於肯塔基州路易維爾的聯合包裹服務公司世界港.每天有200萬個包裹途經這裡,全靠幕後一班戴著安全帽的英雄實現這一切.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and its up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物.他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食.他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.programme_title_tc: 揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋
epg.programme_title_en: Barbie Uncovered: A Dream House Divided
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie Uncovered reveals the dramatic true story behind Barbie’s creation, spotlighting the rise and fallout of co-creators Ruth Handler and Jack Ryan, and the lasting impact of their iconic, controversial invention.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線,注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌.從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.
